deployment_target: Raspberry Pi via systemd (parent monolith). No new deployment artefacts — the revamp is a pure UI/widget refactor. No Dockerfile, no docker-compose.yml, no new env vars. Inherits the parent project's DEPLOYMENT.md and the systemd unit files under deploy/. Project Phase 5 rejection history (2026-03-18) and the help-page / insights-engine / lan-devices feature precedents establish this deployment posture deliberately. The 6 new vanilla-JS widget files ship inside the existing embed.FS (web/static/js/widgets/) — no separate publish step.

requirement_compliance.title: Unit-aware numeric stepper with inline range hint
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-SR-057e verifica que un valor fuera de paso se renderiza literal; TC-SR-057E2E lleva el stepper a su maximo declarado y comprueba que pulsar + no cambia el valor.

requirement_compliance.title: Severity segmented control with semantic colours
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-SR-058e exige como maximo un segmento marcado por radiogroup; TC-SR-071e mide las cajas reales a 375 px y exige que cada segmento conserve area de pulsacion y etiqueta, y que el grupo no provoque scroll horizontal.

requirement_compliance.title: Chip-preset cooldown row with custom escape hatch
requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_SR_059h_ChipPresetCooldownHighlights asserts the 4 presets (1m/5m/15m/1h) render with the 15m chip data-active=true. TestTC_SR_059e_ChipPresetHasCustomEscapeHatch confirms the custom stepper escape hatch coexists with the chips. TestTC_SR_059f_ChipPresetNoPresetWireField confirms the wire format is unchanged (no 'preset' key sent to the server).

requirement_compliance.title: Single source of truth for numeric range strings
requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_SR_060h_ValidationErrorContainsHintWithEnDash asserts the validation error string contains the exact en-dash hint from RangeFor(). TestTC_SR_060h_HintFormatPerUnit covers all 11 registered fields. TestTC_SR_060e_RegistryCoversFields drift-tests the field set. TestTC_SR_060f_UnknownFieldPanics enforces panic-on-typo. The template-side rangeLabel/rangeHint/rangeMin/rangeMax helpers in templates.go bind the same constants.

requirement_compliance.title: Toggle switches for notification 'Enabled' state
requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_SR_061h_NotificationTogglesMarkup verifies the toggle widget for telegram_enabled and email_enabled. The hidden <input type=checkbox name=enabled> remains for backwards-compat (existing TestBackupConfigSave_DisabledPersists still green — confirms wire format unchanged). Toggle JS source (toggle.js) keeps the underlying checkbox in sync.

requirement_compliance.title: Backup section sub-divided into Limits / Schedule / Destination
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-SR-062e recorre los inputs del formulario de Backup y exige que ninguno preceda al primer sub-grupo. Encontro dos toggles huerfanos (BG-083), corregidos anadiendo un sub-grupo General.

requirement_compliance.title: Anchor-chip strip expands target accordion on click and on hash load
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-SR-063h/e/f cubren el clic de chip, la llegada por hash y el uso de replaceState. El del hash encontro BG-084: anchor-chip.js corria expandFromHash antes de que settings.js construyera el acordeon, asi que abrir /settings#seccion no expandia nada. Corregido moviendo la logica de hash al final de initAccordion.

requirement_compliance.title: Single time picker for backup schedule
requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_SR_064h_BackupNewTimeFormAccepted: POST `time=02:30` persisted as hour=2, minute=30. TestTC_SR_064e_BackupBothFormsNewWins: when both `time=` and legacy `hour/minute` present, new format wins. TestTC_SR_064f_BackupOutOfRangeTime400: `time=25:00` returns 400 with the canonical message. TestTC_SR_064f_BackupLegacyHourOutOfRange400: legacy `hour=24` still returns 400.

requirement_compliance.title: Form-state pill is hidden when idle
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-SR-065e mide dentro de la pagina, con performance.now(), que la pastilla de guardado aparece en menos de 100 ms; medirlo desde Go habria medido el viaje de CDP.

requirement_compliance.title: Section number badges removed
requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_SR_066h_NoNumberBadges asserts no `>01<` to `>07<` substrings appear in any section header. TestTC_SR_066e_SectionsInOrder confirms section ordering is preserved by data-section attributes.

requirement_compliance.title: Logout moves to header dropdown; Shutdown gets distinct destructive treatment
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-SR-073f abre la guarda de confirmacion escrita y exige que el boton de envio siga deshabilitado sin la palabra.

requirement_compliance.title: Encryption-key composite picker with live resolution probe
requirement_compliance.evidence: Probe handler is fully tested at the unit level: TestTC_SR_068h (env-found), TestTC_SR_068e (env-missing), TestTC_SR_068f (unauth 401), TestTC_SR_068sec1_ResponseShapeLockedEnum (golden response shape across 6 scheme/value combos), TestTC_SR_068sec2_PathTraversalRejected (3 traversal patterns), TestTC_SR_068sec3_NullByteRejected (literal NUL), TestTC_SR_068sec1_EnvNameRejectsUnsafe (no echo of attacker input). Probe response is locked to {ok, reason} — never exposes key bytes/length/hash (NFR-032). HTMX-driven blur probe (TC-SR-068E2E) manually verified — declared in tech_debt_inherited.

requirement_compliance.title: English-only copy on settings + sidebar tooltip
requirement_compliance.evidence: TC-SR-069f comprueba el tooltip del colapso de la barra lateral en ingles; TC-SR-069h recorre todas las plantillas buscando cadenas en espanol.

requirement_compliance.title: Form widths align with shell width
requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_SR_070h_NoMaxW4xlOnForms asserts no occurrence of max-w-4xl in the settings shell. Viewport-margin symmetry (TC-SR-070e) manually verified — declared in tech_debt_inherited.

technical_debt_inherited.substitution: Los tests de navegador viven tras la etiqueta de compilacion 'e2e' y no corren en un 'go test ./...' normal.
technical_debt_inherited.reason: Necesitan un binario de Chrome real. Sin la etiqueta, una maquina sin Chrome veria fallar la suite por defecto, que convierte 'no tengo navegador' en 'el producto esta roto'. El test_runner del manifiesto si pasa -tags e2e, asi que verify-run los ejecuta y el gate de cobertura de AC los cuenta.
